csrfToken.description: Obtain from /api/auth/csrf using the matching cookie session. The frontend transport supplies this header automatically.
csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

portalCookie.description: HttpOnly portal session cookie issued by sign-in. Browsers send it with credentials included.
portalCookie.name: scp_access

info.description: Portal HTTP contracts. Cookie-authenticated writes require a CSRF token from /api/auth/csrf in X-CSRF-Token. Bank integration remains paused; manual statement imports are supported.
info.title: Secure Client Portal API
